L28: # Clinical Trials
L29: 
L30: Veterinary Cancer Care participates in clinical trials that give companion animals access to emerging treatments in veterinary oncology. Enrollment may be available at reduced or no cost, and participation contributes to advances in animal cancer care. Dr. Kelly reviews each case individually to determine whether a trial may be appropriate for your companion. Please note we still carry and prescribe Canalevia in-clinic for our patients.
L31: ## Current Trials
L32: 
L33: No trials are currently enrolling; check back or ask our team.
